sentences.en: Way back in the 3rd century AD,
a monk in the Egyptian desert warned of evil spirits people should try to overcome.
sentences.zh: 埃及沙漠中的一位僧侣就曾警告过人们应当克服的邪灵。

sentences.en: In Christianity, these became known as the seven deadly sins.
sentences.zh: 在基督教中，这些被称为七宗罪。

sentences.en: Pride, gluttony, greed, lust, sloth, wrath, and one more.
sentences.zh: 傲慢、暴食、贪婪、色欲、怠惰、愤怒，还有一个。

sentences.en: It's an ugly, miserable, unflattering emotion.
sentences.zh: 这是一种丑陋、痛苦且难堪的情感。

sentences.en: Everyone, at some time or another, will experience this feeling
sentences.zh: 每个人在某个时刻都会经历这种感受，

sentences.en: of wanting what someone else has and resenting them for having it.
sentences.zh: 渴望拥有别人拥有的东西，并对他们拥有这些感到怨恨。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Jessica Kyle from Atlanta, Georgia.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫杰西卡·凯尔，来自佐治亚州亚特兰大。

sentences.en: In 2014, Jessica and her best friend traveled to the remote Comoros Islands in the Indian Ocean.
sentences.zh: 2014年，杰西卡和她的最好朋友前往了印度洋上偏远的科摩罗群岛。

sentences.en: They were there to teach English.
It was meant to be a grand adventure and could have been a high point in their friendship.
sentences.zh: 这本该是一场宏大的冒险，也本可以成为她们友谊的巅峰时刻。

sentences.en: Except, Jessica and her friend got sick, really sick, with dengue fever.
sentences.zh: 然而，杰西卡和她的朋友生病了，病得很重，感染了登革热。

sentences.en: I was single and she was married to a doctor.
sentences.zh: 我当时单身，而她嫁给了一位医生。

sentences.en: And her husband was really worried about her and was able to get her evacuated to Kenya.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫非常担心她，并设法把她撤离到了肯尼亚。

sentences.en: To a hospital with air conditioning, good food, and excellent medical care.
sentences.zh: 去了一家有空调、有好食物和优质医疗护理的医院。

sentences.en: Jessica, meanwhile, was stuck on the island.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，杰西卡被困在了岛上。

sentences.en: Where it was about 100 degrees and we had no electricity and I was very hot and didn't have any good food.
sentences.zh: 那里大约有100华氏度（约38度），我们没有电，我感到非常炎热，也没有任何好吃的。

sentences.en: Jessica couldn't stop thinking about how her friend was getting much better care than she was.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡忍不住一直在想，为什么她的朋友得到的照顾比她好得多。

sentences.en: Now, besides being sick, Jessica felt she was suffering from a new malaise.
sentences.zh: 现在，除了生病之外，杰西卡觉得她还患上了一种新的心病。

sentences.en: I was really, really envious of her to the point where it was actually physically painful.
sentences.zh: 我真的、真的很嫉妒她，甚至达到了感到身体疼痛的程度。

sentences.en: Other than just having dengue fever, that envy I felt because I wanted to be in her place.
sentences.zh: 除了患有登革热，我感到的那种嫉妒是因为我想要取代她的位置。

sentences.en: Indeed, that is the purpose of envy.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这就是嫉妒的目的。

sentences.en: It's a tool for social comparison.
sentences.zh: 它是一个社会比较的工具。

sentences.en: It cues you into your relative position among friends, colleagues, and peers.
sentences.zh: 它提示你在朋友、同事和同龄人中的相对位置。

sentences.en: In Jessica's case, she was clearly in a weaker position than her friend.
sentences.zh: 就杰西卡而言，她显然处于比朋友更弱势的地位。

sentences.en: The envy was sounding the alarm.
Jessica did eventually recover, as did her friend.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡最终康复了，她的朋友也是。

sentences.en: And when they were reunited, Jessica told her friend about the pain of being abandoned.
sentences.zh: 当她们重聚时，杰西卡向她的朋友倾诉了被抛弃的痛苦。

sentences.en: And it took several conversations with her when she got back on the island,
sentences.zh: 她回到岛上后，我们经过了好几次谈话，

sentences.en: explaining how much I was hurt by that, knowing it wasn't her fault,
sentences.zh: 我向她解释这件事对我造成了多大的伤害，虽然我知道这不是她的错，

sentences.en: but still needing to get those feelings out there.
sentences.zh: 但我仍然需要把这些感受宣泄出来。

sentences.en: She's still one of my best friends and I did get over it eventually, but it was really, really hard.
sentences.zh: 她依然是我最好的朋友之一，我最终也放下了，但这真的、真的很艰难。

sentences.en: Of course, not all stories of envy end with growth and understanding.
sentences.zh: 当然，并非所有关于嫉妒的故事都以成长和理解告终。

sentences.en: Very often, envy leads to wicked places and tragic consequences.
sentences.zh: 很多时候，嫉妒会引向邪恶的地方并导致悲剧性的后果。

sentences.en: People started sending me a link to a story about people in the Gaza Strip
sentences.zh: 人们开始向我发送一个链接，讲的是加沙地带的故事，

sentences.en: or people in Israel who were sitting on their couches,
sentences.zh: 或者以色列人坐在沙发上，

sentences.en: watching bombs get lobbed at the other side and cheering.
sentences.zh: 看着炸弹被投向对方并欢呼。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, we bring you a favorite episode from 2018
sentences.zh: 本周的《隐藏的大脑》中，我们为您带来2018年的一期热门节目，

sentences.en: that delves deeply into an emotion most of us prefer to hide.
sentences.zh: 深入探讨了一种我们大多数人倾向于隐藏的情感。

sentences.en: It's an emotion that can have a positive side,
sentences.zh: 这是一种具有积极方面的情感，

sentences.en: prompting us to take steps to improve our lives.
sentences.zh: 它促使我们采取行动来改善我们的生活。

sentences.en: But envy can often turn malicious,
sentences.zh: 但嫉妒往往会变得恶毒，

sentences.en: prompting us to resentment, rage, even revenge.
sentences.zh: 促使我们产生怨恨、愤怒，甚至是复仇。

sentences.en: It's hard to imagine life without the pleasure of happiness
sentences.zh: 很难想象没有快乐的喜悦，

sentences.en: or the pain of deep sadness.
sentences.zh: 或没有深深悲伤的痛苦的生活。

sentences.en: These emotions help make us whole.
sentences.zh: 这些情感让我们变得完整。

sentences.en: They give us a way to understand life in all its beauty and suffering.
sentences.zh: 它们为我们提供了一种理解生活中所有美丽与痛苦的方式。

sentences.en: But an emotion like envy is entirely different.
sentences.zh: 但像嫉妒这样感情则完全不同。
它让人感到厌恶、毫无用处。

sentences.en: But of course, that's far from the truth.
sentences.zh: 但当然，这与事实相去甚远。

sentences.en: Envy, in fact, drives us in fascinating ways,
sentences.zh: 事实上，嫉妒以迷人的方式驱动着我们，

sentences.en: sometimes making us better people, sometimes not.
sentences.zh: 有时让我们成为更好的人，有时则不然。

sentences.en: where any good conversation on envy should begin,
sentences.zh: 任何关于嫉妒的精彩谈话都应该开始的地方说起，
这很有趣，因为这是事实。

sentences.en: Homer is an excellent example of pretty much all the seven deadly sins.
sentences.zh: 荷马是几乎所有七宗罪的绝佳代表。

sentences.en: I'm just a big toasty cinnamon bun.
sentences.zh: 我只是一个温暖酥脆的大肉桂卷。

sentences.en: I never want to leave this bed.
sentences.zh: 我永远不想离开这张床。

sentences.en: Homer is also consumed with envy,
especially of his do-gooder neighbor, Ned Flanders.
sentences.zh: 尤其是对他那个循规蹈矩的邻居内德·弗兰德斯。

sentences.en: You know, if you gave Ned Flanders a chance...
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你给内德·弗兰德斯一个机会……

sentences.en: Look, I don't care if Ned Flanders is the nicest guy in the world.
sentences.zh: 听着，我才不管内德·弗兰德斯是不是世界上最好的人。
荷马对弗兰德斯恨之入骨。

sentences.en: Well, Flanders is a pillar of the community.
sentences.zh: 好吧，弗兰德斯是社区的中流砥柱。

sentences.en: Well, we can't hold it against them,
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们不能因此责怪他们，

sentences.en: just because he has things a little better than we do.
sentences.zh: 只因为他过得比我们稍微好一点。

sentences.en: You really put me in my place.
sentences.zh: 你真把我贬得一文不值。

sentences.en: It's worth feeling three inches tall
sentences.zh: 为了弄清楚你到底是怎样一个人，

sentences.en: to find out what kind of a person you really are.
sentences.zh: 感到自己渺小得像个三寸丁也是值得的。

sentences.en: Marge Simpson, president of the international

sentences.zh: “我们爱弗兰德斯”粉丝俱乐部主席。

sentences.en: Usually, Homer is left to stew in his own bitter bile.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，荷马只能在自己痛苦的怨气中煎熬。

sentences.en: But one day, Flanders does something unusual.
sentences.zh: 但有一天，弗兰德斯做了一件不同寻常的事。

sentences.en: He announces he's quitting his job.
As of Friday, I'm saying toodaloo to the pharmaceutical game.
sentences.zh: 从周五开始，我要对制药行业说拜拜了。

sentences.en: What are you going to do, Ned?
Well, sir, like one out of every nine Americans,
sentences.zh: 哦，先生，就像九分之一的美国人一样，

sentences.en: And let me tell you, it ain't all peaches and cream.
sentences.zh: 老实说，生活并非一帆风顺。
你写字时字迹会被抹糊。

sentences.en: Lord help you if you want to drive a standard transmission.
sentences.zh: 如果你想开手动挡的车，上帝保佑你。

sentences.en: Well, sir, I'm opening up a one-stop store for southpaws.
sentences.zh: 哦，先生，我要开一家专为左撇子提供一站式服务的商店。
到左撇子齐特琴，应有尽有。
我得把它叫做“左撇子之家”。

sentences.en: A store with gadgets for left-handed people.
sentences.zh: 一家为左撇子提供小玩意的商店。

sentences.en: Finally, Homer feels he has the upper hand.
sentences.zh: 终于，荷马觉得自己占了上风。

sentences.en: The leftorium, he believes, is a truly stupid idea.
sentences.zh: 他认为，“左撇子之家”真是一个愚蠢透顶的主意。

sentences.en: Homer dreams that it will finally lead to Flanders' downfall.
sentences.zh: 荷马梦想着这最终会导致弗兰德斯的垮台。

sentences.en: I'm telling you, Flanders' store was deserted.
sentences.zh: 我跟你说，弗兰德斯的店冷冷清清。

sentences.en: So what do you think of your bestest buddy now, Marge?
sentences.zh: 那你现在怎么看你最好的好伙伴，玛姬？

sentences.en: Dad, do you know what schadenfreude is?
sentences.zh: 爸爸，你知道什么是幸灾乐祸吗？

sentences.en: No, I do not know what schadenfreude is.
sentences.zh: 不，我不知道什么是幸灾乐祸。

sentences.en: Please tell me because I'm dying to know.
sentences.zh: 请告诉我吧，因为我急于想知道。

sentences.en: It's a German term for shameful joy.
sentences.zh: 这是一个德语词，意思是耻辱的快乐。

sentences.en: Taking pleasure in the suffering of others.
sentences.zh: 从别人的痛苦中寻找快乐。

sentences.en: I'm just glad to see him fall flat on his butt.
sentences.zh: 我只是很高兴看到他摔个四脚朝天。

sentences.en: He's usually all happy and comfortable
sentences.zh: 他平时总是那么开心、舒适，

sentences.en: What's the opposite of that shameful joy thing he hears?
sentences.zh: 他听到的那个耻辱的快乐的反义词是什么？

sentences.en: Boy, those Germans have a word for everything.
sentences.zh: 天哪，德国人对什么都有一个词。

sentences.en: Part of what makes Homer Simpson such an interesting character
sentences.zh: 荷马·辛普森之所以如此有趣，

sentences.en: is that he happily and openly expresses thoughts and feelings
sentences.zh: 部分原因在于他快乐而公开地表达了许多人

sentences.en: many of us secretly identify with,
sentences.zh: 内心深处暗自认同的想法和感受，

sentences.en: including Envy and its nasty sidekick, schadenfreude.
sentences.zh: 包括嫉妒及其讨厌的伴侣——幸灾乐祸。

sentences.en: Envy taps into a dark side of human behavior.
sentences.zh: 嫉妒触及了人类行为黑暗的一面。

sentences.en: But that doesn't mean it's without value.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着它毫无价值。

sentences.en: Like all emotions, it has a purpose.
sentences.zh: 像所有的情感一样，它有它的目的。

sentences.en: The anthropologist Christopher Boehm has written extensively
sentences.zh: 人类学家克里斯托弗·博姆写了大量关于

sentences.en: on the hierarchies that have long existed among our ancestors,
sentences.zh: 长期存在于我们的祖先——

sentences.en: both early hunter-gatherer tribes and our primate relatives.
sentences.zh: 早期狩猎采集部落和我们的灵长类亲戚——之间的等级制度的文章。

sentences.en: Christopher makes two points about the origins of Envy.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗对嫉妒的起源提出了两点看法。

sentences.en: In a hunter-gatherer group, there are always more gifted individuals
sentences.zh: 在一个狩猎采集群体中，总有一些更有天赋的个人，

sentences.en: who are more intelligent sexually and so on.
sentences.zh: 他们在性吸引力等方面更具智慧。

sentences.en: So there are a considerable number of inequalities
sentences.zh: 因此，即使在平均主义的社会里，
也存在着相当数量的不平等。

sentences.en: The other point Christopher makes is that such differences matter.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗提出的另一个观点是，这种差异至关重要。

sentences.en: They're not lost on the members of a tribe.
sentences.zh: 部落成员对此心知肚明。

sentences.en: Even primates pay attention to social ranking.
sentences.zh: 连灵长类动物都十分关注社会等级。

sentences.en: Over half a rheumatologist named Chance,
sentences.zh: 有一位名叫尚斯的风湿病专家做过大半项研究，

sentences.en: baboon behavior in which he discussed the direction of attention.
sentences.zh: 他探讨了狒狒的行为中对注意力的方向。

sentences.en: And he simply measured individuals' gazes were directed
sentences.zh: 他只是以系统化的方式
测量了各个个体的目光投向。

sentences.en: He found that the alpha male, no surprise,
sentences.zh: 他发现毫无意外的是，雄性首领

sentences.en: was gazed at ever so much more than anybody else.
sentences.zh: 比其他任何人都受到更多人的注视。

sentences.en: And it wasn't just the alpha male.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是雄性首领。

sentences.en: Every member seemed to be intimately aware
sentences.zh: 每个成员似乎都非常清楚

sentences.en: of where he or she stood in the hierarchy of the tribe.
sentences.zh: 自己在这个部落层级中所处的位置。

sentences.en: This combination, the reality of inequalities,
sentences.zh: 这种结合，即不平等的现实，

sentences.en: and the fact that we are hardwired to notice them,
sentences.zh: 以及我们天生就会注意到这一事实，

sentences.en: this is the fuel for our endless capacity for Envy.
sentences.zh: 正是我们产生无尽嫉妒心的燃料。

sentences.en: Meena Chikara, a social psychologist at Harvard,
sentences.zh: 哈佛大学的社会心理学家米娜·奇卡拉

sentences.en: says it's exactly the same with humans.
sentences.zh: 表示人类的情况完全一样。

sentences.en: We make sense of the world through social comparisons.
sentences.zh: 我们通过社会比较来理解这个世界。

sentences.en: When you meet a new person,
sentences.zh: 当你遇到一个新人的时候，

sentences.en: there are a lot of things about them that you register immediately,
sentences.zh: 你会立即注意到关于他们的很多事情，

sentences.en: but you don't just register them in some abstract or absolute sense,
sentences.zh: 但你不仅仅是以某种抽象或绝对的意义去注意它们，

sentences.en: you register them relative to yourself.
sentences.zh: 你是参照你自己来注意到它们的。

sentences.en: So not just how tall is this person,
sentences.zh: 所以不仅是这个人有多高，

sentences.en: but how much taller or shorter are they than I am.
sentences.zh: 而是他们比我高多少或矮多少。

sentences.en: We do this because the comparison tells us where we fit in,
sentences.zh: 我们这样做是因为这种比较告诉我们自己的定位，

sentences.en: what our place is in the human hierarchy.
sentences.zh: 我们在人类等级制度中的地位是什么。

sentences.en: What's more, it alerts us to imbalances that might need our attention.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，它提醒我们注意可能需要我们关注的不平衡。

sentences.en: Sometimes the comparisons we make don't matter that much.
sentences.zh: 有时候我们所做的比较其实没那么重要。

sentences.en: I might look at my colleague, Steve Inskey,
sentences.zh: 我可能会看看我的同事史蒂夫·因斯基普，

sentences.en: and notice he not only hosts a popular public radio program,
sentences.zh: 并注意到他不仅主持一个广受欢迎的公共广播节目，

sentences.en: It's morning edition from NPR News.
sentences.zh: 也就是来自NPR新闻的晨间版。

sentences.en: But he also manages to find time to write a new book nearly every other year.
sentences.zh: 而且他几乎每隔一年还能抽出时间写一本新书。

sentences.en: but in a way sociologists call benign.
sentences.zh: 但这种嫉妒是社会学家所称的良性嫉妒。

sentences.en: I don't wish anything bad to happen to him.
sentences.zh: 我并不希望他发生什么不好的事情。

sentences.en: I just wish that I was more like him.
sentences.zh: 我只是希望自己能更像他一些。

sentences.en: Maybe the feeling might push me to work harder.
sentences.zh: 也许这种感觉会促使我更努力地工作。

sentences.en: So if you have more than what I have,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你拥有的比我多，

sentences.en: I may be inspired by what you have.
sentences.zh: 我可能会受到你所拥有的东西的启发。

sentences.en: I may experience these benign forms of envy,
sentences.zh: 我可能会体验到这些良性的嫉妒形式，

sentences.en: which could also manifest as admiration.
I remember this one time in college,
I was going with two girlfriends to go shopping.
sentences.zh: 我和两个女性朋友一起去逛街。

sentences.en: They were about to buy a new table for their apartment.
sentences.zh: 她们正准备为自己的公寓买一张新桌子。

sentences.en: This is Leah Murthy from Houston, Texas.
sentences.zh: 这位是来自得克萨斯州休斯敦的莉亚·默蒂。

sentences.en: On that shopping trip with friends,
sentences.zh: 在那次和朋友的购物之旅中，

sentences.en: she found herself suffering from benign envy.
sentences.zh: 她发现自己正经受着良性嫉妒的折磨。

sentences.en: One of the friends had just gotten married to a senior who had graduated.
sentences.zh: 其中一个朋友刚刚和一个刚毕业的高年级学生结了婚。

sentences.en: And he was out somewhere else in the country making money.
sentences.zh: 他在国内的其他什么地方赚钱。

sentences.en: she checked her bank account before we left.
sentences.zh: 我们在离开前她查看了自己的银行账户。

sentences.en: And that was a substantial amount of money to me back in college days where,
sentences.zh: 在大学时代，对我来说这是一大笔钱，

sentences.en: I only had a few hundred dollars on a good day in my bank account.
sentences.zh: 我手头宽松的时候银行账户里也就几百美元。

sentences.en: Leah was envious of her friend
and the kind of table she could afford.
sentences.zh: 以及她买得起的桌子的档次。

sentences.en: She made it a goal one day to get her own nice table.
sentences.zh: 她把有一天买一张属于自己的好桌子定为一个目标。

sentences.en: My first table that I bought for my apartment was $15 from Goodwill.
sentences.zh: 我为我的公寓买的第一张桌子是从古德威尔二手店买的15美元的桌子。

sentences.en: And of course it didn't laSt.
But years later when we saved and we were patient,
sentences.zh: 但多年以后，当我们存了钱并且有了耐心，

sentences.en: and we finally were able to buy a good table.
sentences.zh: 我们终于能够买一张好桌子了。

sentences.en: It's been with us for almost 10 years now.
sentences.zh: 它现在已经陪伴了我们快10年了。

sentences.en: And I think learning that patience when it came to money and time
sentences.zh: 我认为学会对待金钱和时间的这种耐心

sentences.en: So Leah's envy motivated her to plan and save
sentences.zh: 所以莉亚的嫉妒促使她规划、储蓄

sentences.en: and build the kind of life she wanted.
